title: First FastAPI Routes
learning_objectives: Create a FastAPI application and register path operations with decorators
Declare typed path parameters and get automatic 422 errors
Test an app in-process with TestClient
Relate FastAPI's routing to the router you wrote by hand
hints: `sorted((m, r.path) for r in app.routes if isinstance(r, APIRoute) for m in r.methods)`.

failure_feedback.advice: Annotate `item_id: int` so FastAPI converts it.
With an `int` hint, FastAPI rejects 'abc' with 422 automatically — check the hint.
Register GET and DELETE for /items/{item_id}; FastAPI answers other methods with 405.
Collect `(method, route.path)` for APIRoute objects and sort the list; set the app title.
